title: 第13章 大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
周香兰扭着性感的身子，走上前抓着李大壮的手就往屋里拽。

    周香兰的手虽然不如许红妆的那么纤细，但也柔软白嫩，一点都不像农村女人的手。

    她的背影更是婀娜多姿，波浪长发散在秀美的后背，散发出阵阵洗发水的花香味，水蛇腰扭来扭去，带动的翘臀也跟着扭动，碎花连衣裙垂到大腿处，露出半截白嫩嫩的美腿。

    一举一动间，全是少妇芬芳曼妙，李大壮真是想不通，这么漂亮的女人，她男人是咋舍得跟她离婚的？

    正想入非非呢，周香兰忽然停了下来，李大壮没刹住车，一下撞在了周香兰秀美性感的后背上，由于身高差，大腿还正好贴在周香兰的后翘上，这一下可给周香兰刺激坏了。

    李大壮宽阔的胸膛，精壮有力的大腿，都带着火热的温度，紧贴在她身上，惹得她碎花裙内的皮肉滚烫，尤其是那两座后翘，已经忍不住颤抖起来……

    李大壮感受着周香兰的曼妙，更是“火冒三丈”，那圆滚滚的后翘，咋就这么有弹性呢？

    “嗯~大壮，你个傻小子还挺有劲儿，差点没给人家撞飞~”周香兰娇软的嗔怪，声音也和后翘一样打着颤儿……

    “不好意思，香兰姐，我不小心的。”李大壮挠了挠头，有些依依不舍的后退。

    谁料周香兰竟反手按住李大壮的腰，将他紧按在自己身后，娇喘着说：“好大壮，别走，再跟姐贴一会儿~~姐这样，舒服~~”

    周香兰真是寂寞狠了，甚至都忘了李大壮可能已经不傻了的事儿，只顾着享受这一刻的放松……

    李大壮这下再也压不住了……

    周香兰自然能感受到他的变化，顿时张大了嘴巴，仿佛能塞得下两颗大鸡蛋！

    “大壮，你，你小子也太………”周香兰娇喘吁吁，空虚许久的身子，生出难言的渴望，恨不能化在李大壮怀里……

    “也不知道谁能有福气嫁给你，别说嫁了，就算是只能给你当相好，这辈子也值了啊！”

    “咳咳，香兰姐，别闹了，我一个傻子，给我当相好啥好值的。”李大壮嘴上这么说，身体却越来越不舍得撤离了。

    周香兰竟还不知轻重的晃了下身子，惹得李大壮热火冲天，重重的喘了口粗气！

    周香兰心中难耐，语气更是娇软勾人，仿佛浸泡了蜜水一般：“大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了。”
content_en:
Zhou Xianglan was worthy of being a married woman, she was unrestrained. What she said was so graphic that Li Dazhuang instantly became "more angry", turned around, and changed directions with Zhou Xianglan.

    "Sister Xianglan, you smell so good..."

    In fact, it's not just Zhou Xianglan who smells good, the room she lives in is also fragrant, including the black semi-hollow bra next to the pillow, the purple gauze nightgown, and the looming black panties under the nightgown...

    Even the burgundy bed sheets and quilt cover on the bed exude a seductive feminine fragrance!

    "Silly boy, how sweet is my sister?" Zhou Xianglan seemed to think it was not enough. She bent one of her long white legs and pressed it against Li Dazhuang's side. She looked at him like waves with her watery eyes. While moaning seductively, the collar of her floral skirt was torn open, revealing half of the white...

    "Everywhere smells good, especially here..."

    Li Dazhuang couldn't bear it any longer and pounced on the soft white snow...

    The thunder from the sky will soon stir up the fire on the earth, and the dry land will soon receive the rain she longs for!

    But at such a critical moment, the ringtone of Li Dazhuang's broken cell phone suddenly rang!

    "Dazhuang~Don't~Don't answer it, sister can't wait any longer..."

    Just kidding, Zhou Xianglan had been looking forward to this moment for a long time, how could she let Li Dazhuang off easily? If she didn't wrap his legs around him today, it would be impossible for him to get out of this bed!

    But Li Dazhuang had a bad feeling in his heart, and quickly covered Zhou Xianglan's mouth. When he heard it, he heard a faint quarrel coming from his yard.

    "No, Sister Xianglan, I have to go home first. Let's talk next time!" Li Dazhuang jumped out of the bed. Li Xianglan wanted to stop her, but she was so soft. How could she catch Li Dazhuang?

    "This bastard made me unable to get up, but he ran away. I'm really angry!" Zhou Xianglan's body was still soft, and the exposed half of her body was white. She no longer felt oppressive, not to mention how empty she felt.

    There was really no other way, so she could only cover herself with a summer quilt, imagining that Li Dazhuang hadn't left yet...

    At this time, Li Dazhuang was running away and taking out his mobile phone.

    As expected, it was Sister Qiu Shuang calling.

    "Hey sister..."

    "Come back soon, Da Zhuang! The village chief, Wang Yaogen, and many other people came to our house to cause trouble. Let our parents pay them 100,000 yuan for medical expenses, or we will use our homestead as compensation!"

    Li Qiu Shuang's crying voice came from the other end of the phone.

    Then Wang Yaogen's wretched voice came from the other end of the phone: "Not only do you have to pay for the homestead, you also have to be my wife!!"
title_en: Chapter 14 I can’t wait any longer, I have to get you today~~
